§. 12. Præ primis hic exhibemus nummum Herodis
Tetrarchae, ejusdemque duplex ectypon, primum est
ejus, quem in museo D. Rigordi patricii Massiliensis
servari testatur Norifius ; alterum est nummi, quem
ipsi vidimus inter cimelia ampl. D. de Wilde, quique
pro sua humanitate ejus delineationem misit ad me.

page.notes: The last line's final word is split across the page foot: "ANTI-" stands at the right below the last line and is recorded as catchword. The Greek on the last full line ("ΕΠΙ ΠΕΤΡΩΝΙΥ") is partly worn; the final letter is doubtful. "Norifius" is copied as printed, with its f. Printed "ZK" and "XLIII" are kept as printed. The "Antiocheno-rum" and "Antioche-nos" hyphens are printed line-end hyphens; the "Antiocheno-" word fragment at the end of the last line is also a line-end hyphen, leaving "ANTI-" as catchword. A small dot in the right margin beside the first paragraph is not text and is not transcribed.
